info.name: Puppetry Developer API Beta Audio Uploads Usage API

items.docs: Returns the authenticated workspace's current video credit balance plus monthly credit usage for credit-backed Developer API video jobs. Requires the videos:read scope. When video generation is blocked by active job slots or usage data is temporarily unavailable, the response includes Retry-After and X-Puppetry-Next-Poll-At so agents can pace the next create or usage attempt.
